integrity.date_evidence: arXiv:1405.2486v1 publicly submitted 2014-05-11; not a later journal date

scientific_limitations: The result is a complete finite classification of two specified labelled 16-vertex graphs under one synchronous tie-retaining binary-majority rule, not a family-wide theorem. Most counts are exhaustive computational deductions; a four-support fixed-point distinction is proved structurally. Unindexed priority remains possible.
title: Binary majority clocks distinguish the Shrikhande and rook graphs
